devdoc.details: FutarchyFactory for questions with N answers, such as "Which candidate will win?". The condition has N + 1 outcome slots: one per answer plus INVALID, which wins when Reality answers Invalid or an index >= N. Yes/No proposals, where Invalid counts as No, keep using FutarchyFactory. Each slot is split into both collateral tokens, so a proposal has 2N + 2 wrapped tokens, ordered so that wrappedOutcome(i) and wrappedOutcome(i + N) mean the same as in FutarchyFactory proposals: [answer 0..N-1 of collateral1, answer 0..N-1 of collateral2, INVALID of collateral1, INVALID of collateral2]. Proposals are FutarchyProposal clones whose `outcomes` are the N answers, so numOutcomes() returns N.
